items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I think Barbara Streisand has a little of that.

ctx.x: She had that lyrical sound and I used to have a little bit of that later on when I had my big band, I had a singer named Jean Eldridge that Duke Ellington had discovered. And these girls could sing a ballad with their voices clear, this crystal clear sound, and lyrical. It was our kind of singing. They'd tell you the story and yet the beautiful phrasing of this clear voice. I think Barbara
Streisand has a little of that. Sarah Vaughn, to me, is just --
